threat_event: Ransomware enters through the BAS integrator's remote-support tool and encrypts the BAS server and engineering workstations
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Always-on remote-support tool; shared vendor account; no MFA; no session approval or logging
existing_controls: Remote tool password known only to the integrator; server behind the Property A firewall
treatment_plan: Remove the always-on tool; replace with a remote access gateway requiring named accounts, MFA, and per-session approval by the chief engineer, with session recording

threat_event: BAS cannot be restored after ransomware or server failure because backups are in the production account and controller programs are held only by the integrator
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Weekly image only; same cloud account and region; not immutable; controller programs and graphics not held by the company; never restore-tested
treatment_plan: Daily BAS server backup to a separate, immutable backup account in a second region; obtain and store controller programs and graphics after every change; restore test each quarter

threat_event: Ransomware on the corporate network spreads into the OT segments and door, camera, and BAS devices
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: OT devices share the flat corporate network at Properties B and C; permissive routing at Property A
existing_controls: EDR on corporate endpoints; firewalls at each property
treatment_plan: Separate OT segments at all three properties with deny-by-default rules between corporate and OT; only the BAS historian feed and the access control cloud connection allowed out

threat_event: Attacker exploits the internet-exposed NVR at Property B to gain a foothold on the flat network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: NVR published through port forwarding for guard remote viewing; firmware not current
existing_controls: Guard viewing account has a unique password
treatment_plan: Port forward removed 2026-07-17; guards now view through the vendor cloud console with named accounts; quarterly external scan

threat_event: Former tenant employee uses a badge that was never revoked to enter after hours
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Badges revoked only on tenant request; 212 badges unused for 90+ days; no periodic review
existing_controls: Guards at Property A lobby; turnstiles
treatment_plan: Auto-suspend badges unused for 60 days; quarterly badge roster attestation by each tenant's contact

threat_event: Departed company employee keeps email, property management, or access control administrator access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Accounts disabled about 3 business days after departure
treatment_plan: Same-day disable in the identity provider from the HR termination ticket; monthly reconciliation

threat_event: Attacker on the network uses manufacturer default passwords on BACnet field controllers to change setpoints or stop equipment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Default passwords on 12 field controllers at Property B and 2 NVRs (found in P07 testing); flat network
treatment_plan: Change all default passwords; add to commissioning checklist for new devices

threat_event: Disgruntled insider changes BAS programs to disable chillers, and the shared login prevents attribution
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared engineer login on BAS server and workstations; no BAS audit review
treatment_plan: Named BAS accounts tied to the identity provider where supported; otherwise named local accounts with a monthly review

threat_event: Attacker exploits a known vulnerability in the unsupported operating system on the BAS server
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: OS past vendor support; not in EDR; patched only on integrator visits
treatment_plan: Upgrade BAS server OS and BAS software with the integrator; apply compensating controls (segmentation, allow-listing) until then

threat_event: Business email compromise leads to a fraudulent change of a contractor's bank details and a misdirected payment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Annual video training only; no phishing exercises; no call-back rule for bank changes
existing_controls: MFA on email; SPF and DKIM configured
treatment_plan: Call-back verification for any bank detail change; phishing exercises; set DMARC to reject

threat_event: Tenant bank details or employee Social Security numbers are exfiltrated from a SaaS system through a compromised account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No review of sign-in or export activity
treatment_plan: Weekly identity provider sign-in review; export alerts in the property management system

threat_event: A visitor management vendor breach exposes years of stored driver license scans
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: ID scans and photos kept indefinitely; no retention rule; no vendor review
existing_controls: Vendor-hosted; kiosk access limited to lobby staff
treatment_plan: Set 30-day retention for ID images and 1-year retention for visit logs; purge the backlog; add breach notice terms to the vendor contract

threat_event: Card numbers written on paper booking forms or received by email are stolen, and the company loses SAQ P2PE eligibility
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Paper booking forms with card numbers and security codes in a binder; 3 emails with card numbers in the events mailbox
treatment_plan: Stop writing card data; shred the binder; delete and block card data in email; key card-not-present bookings directly into the P2PE terminal; confirm eligibility with the acquirer

threat_event: A payment terminal is tampered with or swapped to capture card data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No device inspections or tampering training
existing_controls: Terminals kept behind the management office counter
treatment_plan: Weekly inspection log; tampering training for office staff

threat_event: A breach at the BAS integrator or the access control and video integrator gives attackers a path into company systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No security requirements or review for integrators; shared vendor accounts
treatment_plan: Security addendum for integrator and MSP contracts: named accounts, MFA, incident notice within 24 hours, annual security questionnaire

threat_event: Compromise of the MSP's remote management tool reaches every corporate endpoint and the security console PCs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MSP tool has broad access; no MSP security review
existing_controls: MSP uses MFA on its tool (MSP statement)
treatment_plan: Annual MSP security review with its SOC 2 report or questionnaire; restrict tool access by source address

threat_event: Access control cloud platform outage lasts longer than the controllers' cached-credential period
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single cloud service for badge administration
existing_controls: Door controllers cache credentials for up to 72 hours; vendor SOC 2 availability commitments
treatment_plan: Accepted by the COO: residual risk Low; covered by the guard-post workaround in the BIA

threat_event: A hurricane closes one or more properties and damages building equipment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No contingency plan; BAS server on premises at Property A
existing_controls: Hurricane preparation checklist for building shutdown
treatment_plan: Contingency plan with remote BAS access for engineers and a documented restart sequence

threat_event: A long power outage at Property A shuts down the on-premises host that runs the BAS server
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Server room UPS lasts about 30 minutes; generator supports life safety only
treatment_plan: Connect the server room to the generator circuit

threat_event: Attacker activity in the OT segments goes unnoticed because no logs are collected or reviewed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No central logs for BAS, access control administration, firewalls, or remote sessions
existing_controls: EDR alerts on corporate endpoints only
treatment_plan: Send firewall, remote access, and access control administrator logs to the MSP's log service with 1-year retention and weekly review

threat_event: An incident is mishandled because there is no response plan or manual operating procedure, prolonging building outages
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No written incident response plan; no degraded-mode procedures for HVAC or doors
treatment_plan: Adopt POL-03 and the P08 runbook; manual operating procedures; annual tabletop exercise

threat_event: A breach of personal information is not reported within the Florida 30-day deadline, leading to civil penalties
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No breach determination or notification procedure
treatment_plan: Notification matrix (P08) and breach determination procedure; counsel on retainer through the insurer

threat_event: FTC action or tenant claims that the company's security or video analytics practices do not match what it tells tenants
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No written privacy notice for access control and video data
existing_controls: Lease template describes building security services
treatment_plan: Plain-language notice to tenants on access control, video, and analytics data (P10)

threat_event: Tailgating analytics generate many false alerts, so console operators start ignoring real tailgating
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pilot enabled without acceptance criteria or monitoring
treatment_plan: Acceptance thresholds and monthly alert-quality review (P10)

threat_event: Face verification is switched on without assessment, collecting face templates of tenant employees and misidentifying some groups more than others
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor offers the feature in the same platform; no approval gate for new analytics features
treatment_plan: Not approved (P10). Platform change control requires COO approval for any biometric feature

threat_event: A lost engineering tablet exposes cached BAS credentials and building drawings
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 24 tablets not enrolled in device management
treatment_plan: Enroll tablets in device management with remote wipe

threat_event: Building drawings and security system layouts leak from file storage and help plan a physical attack
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Drawings folder shared with outside architects through open links
treatment_plan: Replace open links with named external accounts that expire after 90 days

threat_event: Staff do not report a suspicious event, so an attack is found late
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No incident reporting channel; annual video only
treatment_plan: Publish the incident line; include reporting in training and in console operator procedures

threat_event: Guard contractor staff share one video viewing account, so misuse of footage cannot be traced
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One shared guard account for remote viewing
treatment_plan: Named viewer accounts for each guard in the vendor cloud console

threat_event: Month-start outage of the property management system delays rent collection
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single SaaS dependency
existing_controls: Vendor availability commitments; line of credit
treatment_plan: Accepted by the COO: residual risk Low

threat_event: A change or patch by the BAS integrator breaks HVAC sequences because changes are not planned or tested
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No change management for BAS programs
treatment_plan: Change request with backup-before-change and chief engineer approval

threat_event: A password-spray attack takes over the access control administrator portal
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Internet-facing administrator portal
existing_controls: SSO with MFA through the identity provider; lockout after 10 failures
treatment_plan: Accepted by the COO: MFA already reduces it to Low

threat_event: Malware on a contractor laptop or USB drive is introduced into the BAS network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Contractors connect laptops and USB drives to the BAS network; autorun not disabled on engineering workstations
treatment_plan: Disable autorun and macros; USB control on engineering workstations; contractor laptops scanned before connection

threat_event: No OT asset inventory or network diagram slows containment and recovery during an incident
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No OT inventory or diagram for BAS, access control, or video devices
treatment_plan: Build the OT inventory and network diagrams with the integrators; review each year
